Annndddd here’s the method cus I hate to be annoying: 1. Azelaic acid + a retinoid 2. Barrier serum twice per day 3. Moisturiser AND sunscreen for max hydration 4. Double cleansing with an oil based cleanser that matches my specific criteria (too long to explain here, but there are some specific ingredients I recommend avoiding if you're acne-prone that will help you be much more successful with oil cleansers) 5. LED mask Rinse and repeat for the next five years. My whole method is based around the fundamentals of skin never changing. Skincare companies can release tonnes of new products that are all new and exciting. That doesn't mean our skin actually needs them. In fact, they rarely do. A deep dive into the method is pinned on my profile.
